stages.title: The studio signs in to an empty system
stages.why: An empty database must read as empty, never as a finished day.

admin.message: the dashboard opens on What needs you today
it says the system is empty rather than showing a clear day
no all-clear language over an empty database

stages.title: A lead arrives and gets a first response
stages.why: firstResponseAt is stamped once and must never move — if it can be edited it stops meaning anything.

admin.message: the lead appears in the pipeline
first response is stamped with a real timestamp
logging it a second time does NOT move the date — the number stays meaningful

stages.title: The deal is proposed, then signed
stages.why: A proposal is not revenue. MRR must not move until the retainer is actually signed.

admin.message: break-even gap is still shown
the PROPOSED retainer is not counted as revenue

once signed, the retainer appears in MRR (tile reads "Rs 25,000", org is {"doc":{"kind":"client","status":"active","retainer":25000,"retainerStatus":"signed"},"orgCount":1,"signedCount":1,"sumIfComputedHere":25000})

stages.title: A project is created; the client still cannot see anything
stages.why: Data existing is not the same as the client being able to reach it. Access is a separate, deliberate act.

admin.message: project created

client.message: the client signs in but sees NOTHING — there is no users document yet

stages.title: The studio grants access — the second half of creating a login
stages.why: The trap this whole runbook exists for: an Auth user without a users document signs in fine and sees a blank portal.

client.message: the same client, same login, now sees their project
and sees nothing belonging to anyone else

stages.title: The studio raises what it needs from the client
stages.why: This is the reason the portal exists: the client sees, dated, that they are the holdup.

admin.message: 4 requirements raised as dated blockers
pushing the same scope again adds nothing — no duplicates on the client's list

client.message: the client sees the request list without being told about it
the list renders (0 interactive items found)

stages.title: The quotation is recorded as the project's agreed scope
stages.why: The quote used to be printed and thrown away, so 'how far along are we' was a percentage typed from memory. Recorded, it becomes the one place progress is derived from.

admin.message: 2 lines recorded as the agreed scope
nothing built yet reads as 0% — a scoped-and-untouched project, not an unscoped one
₹65,000 agreed, ₹0 accepted — sold is not earned
re-saving the same quote adds nothing — no duplicate scope lines
and the line marked delivered is still delivered, not silently reset to agreed
progress is weighted by build days, not line count (36%, not the 45% counting lines would give)
the same lines, and the same derived number, on the studio's own delivery tab

client.message: the client sees the same agreed scope, on their own portal
including which parts are done — without anyone sending a status email
but cannot move a line themselves — delivery status is the studio's assertion, enforced by rules

stages.title: The client answers one of the requests
stages.why: One of only two writes a client is permitted anywhere in the system.

admin.message: the studio sees the tick immediately, no refresh dance

client.message: the client ticks "Cash on delivery: COD order value limits, …"

stages.title: The studio schedules the work
stages.why: A project with no milestones cannot tell anyone whether it is late.

admin.message: 6 milestones stamped from the template and a real start date

client.message: the client can now see where the project is going

stages.title: A deliverable goes up for approval
stages.why: The client approves in one click, and the studio sees the decision.

admin.message: the studio sees it approved
and who approved it is recorded

client.message: the client sees it waiting on their approval
the client approves it

stages.title: An invoice is raised and the client tries to pay
stages.why: Razorpay is not configured against the emulator, so this proves the graceful path: the button says payment is off rather than erroring.

client.message: the client sees the invoice
for the right amount
with a Pay now button on the unpaid invoice
unconfigured payment fails gracefully: "Something went wrong with the payment. Nothing has been charged twice "

stages.title: The studio marks the invoice paid
stages.why: Only the admin may write an invoice. The client's view follows.

client.message: the client's invoice now reads paid
and the Pay button is gone — a paid invoice cannot be paid twice

stages.title: Isolation, from inside the client's own session
stages.why: The oldest open item in the project. It only proves anything from a client session — as admin it correctly reports inconclusive.

admin.message: the same page run as admin says inconclusive rather than claiming a pass

client.message: the client cannot reach another tenant's data
no leak reported

stages.title: Back to the dashboard — has the day's work moved the numbers?
stages.why: The Today panel must reflect everything that just happened.

admin.message: MRR includes the signed retainer
the unscheduled-project warning is gone
no duplicate-intake warning
